headlines.text: Rewind to 2021, when Trent Beretta laced up for their first AEW match against Best Friends & Cassidy vs. The SuperKliq vs. Best Friends vs. The Young Bucks vs. Chuck Taylor vs. Orange Cassidy vs. Rocky Romero vs. Adam Cole vs. Matt Jackson vs. Nick Jackson vs. Bobby Fish, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.34 ? a well-worked match. Part of an eight-man tag showcase pitting Adam Cole's Super Elite against the returning Best Friends, a fun, high-energy outing on a stacked go-home show before the holidays.
That Wednesday in 2025, The Elite vs. Hechicero, Okada & Takeshita met for the very first time on Dynamite, rated 7.94 ? a strong outing.
Turning the clock back to 2025: PAC vs. Kyle Fletcher met in a Continental Classic League Match on Dynamite, rated 7.89 ? a good, competitive contest ? part of that year's Holiday Bash '25 - Night 1.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2025: Bandido vs. Ricochet vs. Ace Austin vs. Anthony Bowens vs. Bishop Kaun vs. Brody King vs. Josh Alexander vs. Luchasaurus vs. Mark Davis vs. Max Caster vs. Shelton Benjamin vs. Toa Liona settled things in a Battle Royal match, serving as the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 4.61 ? part of that year's Holiday Bash '25 - Night 1.

2025 brought us this moment: FTR vs. A.Gunn & Robinson put the AEW World Tag Team Titles on the line, appearing on Collision, rated 6.87. It was the first title opportunity of A.Gunn & Robinson's career.

That Wednesday in 2025, Jon Moxley vs. Roderick Strong met in a Continental Classic League Match, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 7.44 ? a well-worked match, part of the special Holiday Bash '25 - Night 1 card.
